digest.component_or_area: ticket directory creation in store write path
propositions: Directory creation and first event file write in ticket creation are not atomic, allowing interruptions to leave empty ticket directories flagged by fsck as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH
The vulnerable window exists in _prepare_event which runs os.makedirs outside the write lock, with the first event file only landing later at os.replace inside the lock

New staging module publishes directory and CREATE event atomically via os.rename under the write lock, with staging dirs named .tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex> to remain invisible to fsck by existing dot-prefix exclusion rules
The fix applies to all dir-then-file sites in the store write path: single-event stage_and_commit, batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, and dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT emission

Stale staging directories from dead processes are cleaned on next writer start using process ownership verification (host+pid-namespace+start-time stamp) without touching ticket directories or event data
